content: Did you meet the new girl in our sales department. She is taking the place of Maggie during her alternative leave.
Did they finally fill that post, how come I haven't seen her? She must have not been inducted yet.
I guess not, They haven't officially introduced her to the whole staff yet, she barely started yesterday.
Is she just working temporarily? What are they going to do when Maggie comes back from leave.
If the new girl is competent, maybe they will promote her when that time comes.
